info.name: My Dream Board API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the My Dream Board mobile app and admin dashboard.

## Getting started
1. Import `My-Dream-Board.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Run **Auth > Register** then **Auth > Verify Email** (the OTP is printed in the server console in development).
3. Or run **Auth > Login** with an existing account. Tokens are saved to the environment automatically.
4. Run **Admin > Login as Admin** to populate `{{adminToken}}` for every admin folder.

Every request except the public ones inherits bearer auth from `{{accessToken}}`. Admin requests override it with `{{adminToken}}`.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign Up, Sign In, Forgot Password, Enter OTP and Reset Password screens.

OTP policy: 6 digits, 5 minute expiry, 45 second resend cooldown, 5 verify attempts. Every OTP response returns `resendAfter` so the client countdown is server-authoritative.

request.description:
Sign Up screen. Creates an unverified account and emails a 6 digit OTP. Returns `{ email, expiresIn, resendAfter }` and NO tokens - the client should route to the Enter OTP screen.

Accepts either `userName` or `firstName`/`lastName`; the other form is derived automatically.
Enter OTP screen (signup flow). On success returns the user plus access and refresh tokens, which are saved to the environment.

Sign In screen. Saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to the environment.

If the account is unverified the API responds 403 with `data.needsVerification = true` and re-sends the OTP, so the client can route to the Enter OTP screen.

Optionally pass `deviceToken` and `platform` to register for push in the same call.
Silent refresh with rotation - the old refresh token is revoked.
Forgot Password screen. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists (anti account-enumeration).

RESEND OTP button. Returns 429 with the remaining seconds if called inside the 45 second cooldown.

`type` is `email_verification` or `password_reset`.

Enter OTP screen (reset flow). Returns a single-use, short-lived `resetToken` saved to the environment.

If `type` is `email_verification` this behaves like Verify Email and returns tokens instead.

exec: if (res.data) { const v = res.data.resetToken; if (v) pm.environment.set('resetToken', v); }

The two stat cards. Each returns BOTH the raw count and a percentage so the frontend can render either:
- `totalUsers.percent` = value / ADMIN_USER_TARGET (env var, default 100)
- `activeUsers.percent` = active / total (active = seen in the last 30 days)
- `changePercent` and `trend` drive the up/down arrow
The "Registration rate" bar chart. Sun..Sat buckets, always zero-filled, with both `count` and `percent` per day.
The "User Growth" area chart. Jan..Dec with `newUsers` and a running cumulative `totalUsers`, seeded by `carryIn` (the user count before Jan 1) so the curve does not restart each year.
The recent users table under the charts.
